_comment: Max channel delta of any pixel, and the fraction of pixels whose delta exceeds 8 / 32, between the browser's render of the reference frame and wgpu-native's. Measured on Intel Iris Xe (Vulkan): firefox 0 / 0 / 0, chrome 113 / 8.7e-5 / 8.3e-5. Limits sit just above those; re-measure per CI rasterizer (lavapipe, SwiftShader).
